title: SK hynix signs ~$4.3B, five-year EUV tool deal with ASML

sources.quote: SK Hynix, world's second-largest memory chip maker, said on Wednesday it had agreed a five-year procurement contract worth 4.8 trillion won ($4.34 billion) with ASML Holding N.V. to secure extreme ultraviolet (EUV) scanners used in manufacturing chips.
SK Hynix said on Wednesday that it will be spending 4.75 trillion won (around US$4.3 billion) up to December 1, 2025 to procure extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography equipment.

explain: SK hynix agreed to buy EUV lithography machines, the most advanced chipmaking tools, which only ASML makes, for about 4.75 trillion won (about $4.3 billion) over five years through 2025, to produce advanced DRAM memory. The figure comes from SK hynix's Korean regulatory filing as reported by news outlets.
